statement: Adult mice regenerate new hair follicles de novo in the centre of large full-thickness wounds through a Wnt-dependent process resembling embryonic follicle development.

measurement.endpoint: de novo follicle formation in healed wound
measurement.effect: new follicles form in large wounds; blocked by Wnt inhibition, enhanced by Wnt

replication.note: Widely reproduced in mice since (not cited here); no human report located.

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (PubMed) and Crossref metadata, checked 2026-09-11; no source opened at figure level
